appearance.extreme: The air bends slightly above their shoulders. Snow doesn't settle on them, and standing close is like standing near a stove.
appearance.obvious: Heat comes off them in the cold like off an engine. They're in shirtsleeves and comfortable.
appearance.subtle: They're running warm, and there's a sheen of sweat on them in a cold room.

description: You run hot. Genuinely hot, all the time, burning through food to do it. The cold can't touch you and the heat nearly kills you.
name: Cold-Shedding Metabolism
